Exclusive US wholesaler

Piher TS bolts for 16mm tables

For decades, Piher (pronounced "Peer") has been a trusted name in clamping tools, making them in Logroño, Spain since 1957. Weld Brothers is the exclusive wholesaler for Piher TS bolts in the United States.

Piher backs its tools with a 5-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

Our story

Join the Weld Brothers on the journey

The story of the Weld Brothers began over thirty years ago with a business relationship between Mark Blakely and his customer, Jim Neimeister. Over time, they discovered a deep personal connection: both had faced the challenges of cancer. Jim lost his brother, Jace, while Mark's nephew, Quinn, was courageously battling the disease.

A turning point came when Mark introduced Jim to his sister-in-law, Karen, at a fundraising event for a childhood cancer nonprofit. Their connection grew, and Jim and Karen married in 2007, further strengthening their bond and ultimately paving the way for the formation of the Weld Brothers.

Common questions

What do you sell?
Tooling for 16mm and 28mm welding tables, Piher TS bolts and Maxipress clamps, welding tools, and our own 2 LA BLUE tungsten. We are the exclusive US wholesaler for Piher TS bolts, which carry Piher's 5-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
How does pricing work?
Ask for the price list above. We email it once we've confirmed you're a welding supply business.
Where do orders ship from?
From our own stock in Ohio.
Do you help us sell it?
Yes. You can use our part photos and catalogs on your website and at your counter.
